Looking at the qlang documentation, I need to write queries that process JSON/text files and return the specified results. Let me work through each task:

**Understanding key concepts:**
- `|` pipes values through steps
- `*` iterates over elements
- `at` reads softly (returns null if missing)
- `filter ~(...)` filters with conditions
- `groupBy` groups by a key function
- `!|` handles failures

Here are my queries:

T1: /data/users | filter ~(allOf /active (/email | ne null) (/email | lower | endsWith "@example.com")) | count

T2: /data/users | filter ~(/roles | any ~(lower | eq "admin")) | sort ~(/name | lower) | * /name

T3: /data/users | groupBy ~(at /profile | at /country | coalesce "unknown") | * count

T4: /data/users | filter ~((at /profile | at /age) | ne null) | * /profile | * /age | avg | round 2

T5: / | filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * /labels | flat | * /name | * lower | distinct

T6: / | sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | * {:number /number :assignee ((at /assignee | at /login) !| null)}

T7: / | filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * ((/assignee | at /login) !| null) | filter ~(ne null) | groupBy ~(/) | * count

T8: /dependencies | union /devDependencies | entries | filter ~(/value | startsWith "^") | * ((/key | print) | append "@" | append /value) | sort

T9: /services | filter ~(allOf (at /enabled | eq true) (/port | gt 8000)) | * /name | * lower | sort | join ","

T10: / | lines | filter ~((split " " | /1) | eq "ERROR") | * (split " " | /2) | groupBy ~(/) | * count

T11: / | lines | * (if (contains "ms=") (split "ms=" | /1 | split " " | /0 | parseJson) null) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | round 1

T12: / | filter ~(allOf ((/status | lower) | eq "shipped") (/price | ne "")) | * ((/qty | parseJson) | mul (/price | parseJson)) | sum | round 2

T13: / | filter ~(allOf ((/status | lower) | ne "cancelled") (/price | ne "")) | groupBy /customer | entries | * {:customer /key :total ((/value | * ((/qty | parseJson) | mul (/price | parseJson))) | sum | round 2)} | sort ~(/total | desc) | take 2

T14: ["Banana","apple","Cherry","banana","fig","APPLE","date","kiwi","Fig","elderberry"] | * lower | distinct | sort ~([(count | desc) /]) | join "-"
